description: I am not anti-market. I am anti-rigged market.Markets only work when there is transparency, real competition, and meaningful consent. When profit depends on confusion, hidden fees, manufactured complexity, or the fact that ordinary people have nowhere else to go, government neutrality stops being neutral. It becomes complicity.At that point, what we are calling a market is not really a market. It is extraction with better branding.People live with that extraction every day. They feel it in utili
title: Transparency, consumer protection, and accountability
